title.ja: 図1-1 居飛車の例、居角左美濃
title.en: Figure 1-1: Static Rook example, Static Rook Left Mino

explain.ja: 振り飛車は、居飛車に比べて守りが強いことが特徴の戦法です。四間飛車に限らず、振り飛車は基本的に守りの戦法と言われています。この図の居角左美濃は、居飛車の駒組みの一例です。
explain.en: Ranging Rook openings are characterized by a strong defense compared with Static Rook. Not just Fourth-File Rook, Ranging Rook is generally considered a defensive strategy. This figure shows a Static Rook setup with Static Bishop Left Mino castle as an example.

section.ja: 振り飛車は、守りが強いのが特徴
section.en: Ranging Rook's feature is strong defense

title.ja: 図1-2 振り飛車の例、向かい飛車
title.en: Figure 1-2: Ranging Rook example, Opposing Rook

explain.ja: 図の居飛車の例は「居角左美濃」、振り飛車の例は「向かい飛車」で、駒組みが左右反転した形です。どちらも飛車と反対側に玉を動かしており、将棋では飛車と逆側に囲いを作るのがセオリーです。居飛車と振り飛車の一番の違いは、角の位置が玉側にあるか飛車側にあるかです。居飛車では角が玉側、振り飛車では飛車側にあります。飛車のある側を攻めエリア、玉(囲い)のある側を守りエリアとして見直します。
explain.en: The examples are Stationary Bishop Left Mino for Static Rook and Opposing Rook for Ranging Rook, whose piece placements are mirror images. In both, the king moves to the side opposite the rook; in shogi the standard is to build the castle on the opposite side from the rook. The biggest difference between Static Rook and Ranging Rook is whether the bishop is on the king's side or the rook's side: in Static Rook it is on the king's side, in Ranging Rook on the rook's side. Call the rook's side the attack area and the king's (castle) side the defence area.

section.ja: 振り飛車は、守りが強いのが特徴
section.en: Ranging Rook's feature is strong defense

title.ja: 図1-3 居飛車の攻めエリア守りエリア
title.en: Figure 1-3: Attack and defense areas of Static Rook

explain.ja: この図は居飛車の居角左美濃と、振り飛車の向かい飛車の例で、駒組みがほぼ左右反転しています。どちらも飛車と反対側に玉を囲うのが定跡です。一番の違いは角の位置で、居飛車では角が玉側に、振り飛車では飛車側にあります。飛車がある側を攻めエリア、玉(囲い)がある側を守りエリアと考えます。
explain.en: This figure compares a Static Rook setup (Static Bishop Left Mino) and a Ranging Rook setup (Opposing Rook), which are almost mirror images. In both, the castle is built on the side opposite the rook. The key difference is the bishop: in Static Rook it sits on the king side, in Ranging Rook on the rook side. The rook's side is the attack area and the castle's side is the defense area.

section.ja: 振り飛車は、守りが強いのが特徴
section.en: Ranging Rook's feature is strong defense

title.ja: 図1-4 振り飛車の攻めエリア守りエリア
title.en: Figure 1-4: Attack and defense areas of Ranging Rook

explain.ja: 居飛車では角が守りエリアにいて、玉が囲いの奥深くへ入るのを邪魔しますが、飛車と角が同じ地点を狙うので攻撃的な構えです。振り飛車では角が攻めエリアにいて囲いがしっかりしますが、飛車と角が反対を向くため攻めは目立ちません。玉の近くに角がいると深く囲えず、▲7六歩と角道を開ける手が守りをさらに薄めます。
explain.en: In Static Rook the bishop is in the defence area and blocks the king from going deep into the castle, but rook and bishop aim at the same point, so it is aggressive. In Ranging Rook the bishop is in the attack area and the castle is solid, but rook and bishop point in opposite directions, so the attack looks modest. A bishop near the king prevents a deep castle, and opening its diagonal with ▲7六歩 further thins the defence.

section.ja: 振り飛車は、守りが強いのが特徴
section.en: Ranging Rook's feature is strong defense

title.ja: 図1-5 四間飛車の駒組み
title.en: Figure 1-5: Fourth File Rook piece development

explain.ja: 四間飛車も、振り飛車の基本例と同じく角が攻めのエリアにいて囲いがしっかりしています。守りが堅い代わりに攻めが薄く、守ってばかりで相手の攻めが決まるのが四間飛車のよくある負け方です。基本方針は相手の攻めを待ち、うまく飛車交換に持ち込むことです。お互い飛車を持ち駒にして打ち込み合えば、同じ条件で守りの堅い四間飛車が有利になります。このように攻め駒を交換して相殺する指し方を「捌き」と言います。ここまでは四間飛車対居飛車の場合です。まず方針が分かりやすい初心者向けの7八銀型を見ます。
explain.en: Fourth File Rook also has the bishop in the attack area and a solid castle. It is strong in defence and thin in attack, and a common way to lose is to defend passively while the opponent's attack lands. The basic plan is to wait for the opponent's attack and steer into a rook exchange. When both hold a rook in hand and drop it, the Fourth File Rook's sturdier defence is an advantage under equal conditions. Exchanging attacking pieces to cancel them out is called sabaki (捌き). This applies when Fourth File Rook faces Static Rook. First is the beginner-friendly 7八 silver setup, whose plan is easy to see.

section.ja: 四間飛車の狙いは飛車交換の捌き!飛車を持ち合えば堅さが活きる!
section.en: Fourth File Rook aims to get rooks off; if rooks are in hand, solidity pays off!

title.ja: 図2-1 四間飛車7八銀型
title.en: Figure 2-1: Fourth File Rook with silver on 7八

explain.ja: 四間飛車の基本形のまま戦うのが「7八銀型」です。狙いは、タイミングよく▲6五歩と突いて飛車先を伸ばしながら角道を開けることです。6筋の飛車先突破と角交換での捌きを同時に狙えます。▲6五歩は大駒2枚を同時に働かせる四間飛車の必殺技のような手で、初心者にも狙いがわかりやすい手です。
explain.en: The 7八 silver setup keeps the basic Fourth File Rook formation. The aim is a well-timed ▲6五歩, extending the rook's file while opening the bishop's diagonal, aiming for a breakthrough on the 6th file and a bishop exchange at once. ▲6五歩 is like the signature move of Fourth File Rook, activating both major pieces at once, and its aim is easy for beginners to understand.

section.ja: 7八銀型は初心者向け!いきなり飛車角を同時に動かす
section.en: The 7八 silver setup is beginner-friendly! Move rook and bishop at once

title.ja: 図2-2 四間飛車6七銀型
title.en: Figure 2-2: Fourth File Rook with silver on 6七

explain.ja: 銀を6七に構える「6七銀型」は、四間飛車の一番基本の形です。ここからの狙いは、飛車を振り直して相手の飛車にぶつけることです。飛車をぶつけて飛車交換に持ち込めば、美濃囲いの堅さが活きます。
explain.en: The 6七 silver setup, with the silver on 6七, is the most basic Fourth File Rook form. The aim from here is to re-swing the rook to face the opponent's rook. If you clash rooks and force a rook exchange, the Mino castle's solidity pays off.

section.ja: 基本の6七銀型、飛車を振りなおして戦う
section.en: Basic 6七銀 setup: re-swing the rook and fight

title.ja: 図2-3 四間飛車6六銀型
title.en: Figure 2-3: Fourth File Rook with silver on 6六

explain.ja: 銀を前に出す「6六銀型」は、居飛車側が攻めてこずに守りを固めたときに使う形です。そのまま棒銀のように銀を繰り出して攻められます。高美濃囲いに組んでいる場合は、中飛車に振り直す手も有力で、5五に飛車・角・銀が効いて非常に攻撃的です。
explain.en: The 6六 silver setup, with the silver advanced, is used when the Static Rook side does not attack and instead strengthens its defence. The silver can keep advancing like Climbing Silver. If you have built a high Mino castle, re-swinging to Central Rook is also strong, with rook, bishop and silver all covering 5五, a very aggressive formation.

section.ja: 攻撃的な6六銀型、棒銀風に攻めるのが特徴
section.en: Aggressive ▲6六銀 formation: attacks in Rushing Silver style

title.ja: 図2-4 中飛車に振りなおすと攻撃的
title.en: Figure 2-4: Re-ranging to Central Rook is aggressive

explain.ja: 四間飛車にもきちんと攻めの手段があります。これは居飛車側が守りを固めてきたときに使う形です。
explain.en: Fourth File Rook has attacking means of its own. This formation is used when the Static Rook opponent has tightened its defence.

section.ja: 攻撃的な6六銀型、棒銀風に攻めるのが特徴
section.en: Aggressive ▲6六銀 formation: attacks in Rushing Silver style

title.ja: 図2-5 四間飛車5六銀型
title.en: Figure 2-5: Fourth File Rook with silver on 5六

explain.ja: 最後は「5六銀型」です。この形は銀を4五に進めて右側から攻めるときに使います。たとえば高美濃囲いまで組んだ後に、右側の桂馬を活用する場合を考えます。
explain.en: The last is the 5六 silver setup, used when advancing the silver to 4五 and attacking from the right side. For example, consider the case where, after reaching a high Mino castle, you bring the right-side knight into play.

section.ja: 腰掛け銀の5六銀型、右側を攻めていく!
section.en: Koshikake Gin with the 5六 silver formation: attack on the right side!

title.ja: 図2-6 右側を攻める形
title.en: Figure 2-6: Shape that attacks the right side

explain.ja: 図2-6の形では、角・銀・桂が右側を狙っています。相手が居飛車の場合、こちらから見て右側に玉の囲いがあることが多いので、相手玉を直接攻める厳しい手になります。飛車を使わない特殊な攻めですが、5六銀型に普通に組むこともあるので、局面を見て臨機応変に考えます。これで四間飛車の基本の形は終わりで、次回は速攻棒銀との戦いを実戦形式で見ます。
explain.en: In Figure 2-6, bishop, silver and knight aim at the right side. When the opponent plays Static Rook, its castle is usually on our right, so this attacks the king directly. It is a special attack not using the rook, though ordinary 5六 silver setups are also played, so judge by the position. That finishes the basic Fourth File Rook formations; next we look at how to play against the popular fast Climbing Silver in a game-like format.

section.ja: 腰掛け銀の5六銀型、右側を攻めていく!
section.en: Koshikake Gin with the 5六 silver formation: attack on the right side!
